name: Cactus Flats
detailed_description:
Saddle up, partner, and get ready for an adventure like no other in Cactus Flats. This action-packed top-down 2D game drops you right into the heart of the untamed frontier, where danger, opportunity, and adventure await.

 

In Cactus Flats, every day is a new challenge. Take down dangerous outlaws, build your homestead, and brave some harshest terrain. Whether you want to go into an outlaw's hideout, guns blazing, or peacefully tend to the cattle on the ranch, there is something for everyone in this vast, lawless land.

Features: 

  • Classic Wild West Vibes: Immerse yourself in a world of lawless bandits, vibrant towns, and dusty canyons, brought to life in a beautiful pixel art style.

  • Action-packed Combat: From quick-draw duels to brawls in the saloon, this town rarely has idle moments. Keep your wits about you and outsmart the toughest of outlaws with your arsenal.

  • Homesteading & Farming: Build your homestead as you raise cattle, grow crops, and begin living off the land as you establish your stake in the unforgiving frontier.

  • Explore the Frontier: Traverse through various environments, from bustling saloons to dark caves, open desert to steep canyons. There is an adventure awaiting around every corner.

  • Build Your Legend: Take down ruthless outlaws, load up with the best weapons, and craft your story in this immersive world.

  • Casual yet Challenging: A perfect balance of simple gameplay mechanics and unique challenges, whether you are looking for a duel at high noon or a rich story-driven experience.

short_description: Cactus Flats is a top-down western game filled with adventure and excitement. Dive into the Wild West, where you can live the fulfilling life of an up-and-coming rancher and the daring life of a soldier turned cowboy fighting against a crime syndicate looking to take over the region.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
